ui.home.eyebrow: Hanyar sadarwar matuƙan drone ta duniya, tun 2026
ui.home.lead: AubePilot na haɗa matuƙan drone masu lasisi (DGAC, EASA, Transport Canada, FAA, CAA UK, Rosaviatsia, CAAC, JCAB, CASA, ASECNA da sauransu) da mutanen da ke buƙatarsu. Ɗaukar bidiyon bikin aure, taswirar RTK ta wurin haƙar ma'adinai, binciken zafi na injin iska. Ba tare da ɗan tsakani ba, a ko'ina a duniya.
ui.search.missions_intro: Buƙatun da abokan ciniki masu neman matuƙi suka buga. Faɗa mana inda kake: mafi kusa na fara bayyana.
ui.search.pilots_intro: Dukkan matuƙan da ke cikin hanyar sadarwar, tare da lasisinsu, jiragensu da sharhi. Faɗa mana inda kake: mafi kusa na fara bayyana.

ui.home.nearby.title: Gano abin da ke tashi kusa da kai.
ui.home.nearby.lead: Da izininka, muna gano matuƙa da ayyuka a cikin zangon kilomita 100. Ba a adana komai a uwar garke ba; komai na zama a cikin burauzarka.
ui.home.steps.lead: Daga buga aiki har zuwa miƙa hotuna, an gina tafiyar ne domin ka ci gaba da riƙe iko, ko kai abokin ciniki ne mai gaggawa ko matuƙi tsakanin tashi biyu.
ui.home.step1.h: Ka bayyana abin da kake buƙata.
ui.home.step1.p: Nau'i, wuri, lokaci, sharuɗɗa (RTK, zafi, inshora). Filaye biyar, mintuna biyu.
ui.home.step2.h: Matuƙan yankin na ba da tayi.
ui.home.step2.p: Farashi, lokacin kammalawa, saƙo na musamman. Ka kwatanta da maki da lasisi.
ui.home.step3.p: Karɓa = an ajiye. Saƙonni na sirri don shirya dabaru, NOTAM da shiga wurin.
ui.home.step4.p: Matuƙin ya miƙa hotunan. Ka tabbatar, kuɗin ya wuce, kowa ya bar sharhi. Kuɗin hidimar dandali: {fee}%.
ui.home.map.h: Matuƙa da ayyuka, a kan taswira.
ui.home.map.lead: Ƙara girma, matsa, danna alama don buɗe bayanan kai ko aikin. Shuɗi: matuƙa ƙwararru · kore-shuɗi: na nishaɗi · kore: makarantu · lemu: ayyuka a buɗe. An ɓoye ainihin wurin matuƙa da kusan kilomita 10. Sannan danna ƙasa don tacewa.
ui.home.manifesto.h: Matuƙi ba ɗan ƙodago ne da ake watsarwa ba.
ui.home.manifesto.p1: A AubePilot, lasisinka, jiragenka da awoyin tashinka na da muhimmanci kamar farashinka. Ana fitar da hukumomi (DGAC, EASA, TC, FAA, ASECNA) a fili; masu tashi don nishaɗi ma, a matsayinsu.
ui.home.manifesto.p2: Kuma muna karɓar kuɗi ne kawai kan ayyukan da aka kammala. Babu biyan kuɗin wata-wata, babu tallace-tallace masu fitowa.
ui.home.dep.lead: Abokan ciniki na da buƙata kuma suna jiran ƙiyasin farashi. Matuƙi, zaɓi aiki kusa da kai ka ba da farashinka.
ui.home.world.h: Dandali ɗaya ga kowane matuƙi a duniya.
ui.home.world.lead: Duk inda kake, ana ganin matuƙa a nan. Tuntuɓe su, faɗaɗa hanyar sadarwarka, ƙara ƙwarewarka.
ui.home.world.1.h: Ana gani a nan, a ko'ina
ui.home.world.1.p: Matuƙin da ya yi rijista a Montréal, Kano, Lagos ko Yamai na bayyana a jerin sunaye ɗaya, a taswira ɗaya, da alamar lasisin da aka tabbatar iri ɗaya.
ui.home.world.2.p: Saƙo, ƙiyasin farashi, aiki: komai na wucewa ta dandalin, a harshenka, ba tare da ɗan tsakani ba.
ui.home.world.3.p: Matuƙa, makarantu, kamfanonin hidima da shaguna na haɗuwa a wuri ɗaya, a ɓangarorin biyu na kowace iyaka.
ui.home.world.4.p: Nemi makaranta ko horo kusa da kai; ƙara sabbin lasisinka, za a duba su a nuna su a shafinka.
ui.home.world.auth_label: Lasisin da aka amince da su
ui.home.world.all: Duba matuƙa daga ko'ina a duniya →
ui.home.why.h: Fiye da jerin sunaye: aikin gabaɗaya, daga farko har ƙarshe.
ui.home.why.lead: Samun matuƙi a taswira farko ne kawai. A nan ka kwatanta ƙiyasin farashi, ka biya cikin riƙon amana, ka karɓi fayiloli ka bar sharhi — a wuri ɗaya, a harshenka, a ko'ina a duniya.
ui.home.why.1.h: Lasisin da aka tabbatar, ba kawai aka faɗa ba.
ui.home.why.1.p: Matuƙin na loda shaida (DGAC, EASA, Transport Canada, FAA, ASECNA…) kuma ƙungiyarmu na dubawa. Tace don ganin bayanan kai da aka tabbatar kuma masu inshora kawai.
ui.home.why.2.h: Nema ta lambar gidan waya, a ko'ina.
ui.home.why.2.p: Lambar gidan waya, adireshi ko birni: matuƙa da ayyuka na bayyana daga mafi kusa, a taswira da cikin jerin, cikin zangon da ka zaɓa.
ui.home.why.3.p: Ka biya a lokacin ajiya; kuɗin na zama a kulle har sai ka tabbatar da miƙawar. Ana warware rikici, sulhu da mayar da kuɗi a kan dandalin.
ui.home.why.4.h: Ƙiyasin farashi masu kwatantuwa, ana fitar da su a PDF.
ui.home.why.4.p: Kowane matuƙi na bayyana hidimar, abubuwan da za a miƙa, lokacin kammalawa da sharuɗɗa. Ka ƙi, sai ya gyara; ka karɓa, sai ƙiyasin ya zama PDF mai alamar kasuwancinsa.
ui.home.why.5.h: Abubuwan da aka miƙa da sharhi a wuri ɗaya.
ui.home.why.5.p: Hotuna, bidiyo 4K, RAW, orthophoto, girgijen maki: har zuwa 1 GB kowane fayil, kai tsaye a kan ajiyar. Sharhi na zuwa ne kawai daga ayyukan da aka biya da gaske.
ui.home.why.6.h: Harsuna da dama, wayar hannu, babu masu bin sawu.
ui.home.why.6.p: A harshenka, yanayin rana da dare, manhajar Android da allon gida na iPhone. Babu talla, an ɓoye wurare, ana bayyana ainihin mutane bayan biyan kuɗi kawai.
ui.home.join.h: Kai abokin ciniki ne, matuƙi — ko duka biyun?
ui.home.join.lead: Asusu ɗaya, babu biyan kuɗin wata-wata. Kana bayyana a bincike da a taswira da zarar bayanan kanka sun cika; alamar “an tabbatar” na zuwa bayan an duba lasisinka.
ui.home.join.client.p: Buga aiki ko ajiye fakiti, kwatanta ƙiyasin farashi, biya cikin riƙon amana, karɓi fayilolinka.
ui.home.join.pilot.p: Lasisi, jirage, ayyukan baya, fakiti masu tsayayyen farashi, sanarwar ayyuka cikin zangonka, biyan kuɗi ta atomatik.
ui.home.join.both.h: Ina ba da oda kuma ina tuƙi
ui.home.join.both.p: Mai aiki da ke ba wasu ƙarin ayyuka a lokutan cunkoso, makaranta da ke horar da matuƙa tana samo musu aiki: asusu ɗaya, matsayi biyu.
ui.home.join.partner: Makaranta, shago, kamfanin haya? Mu tattauna haɗin gwiwa →
ui.home.contact.p: Abokan ciniki, matuƙa, makarantu, shaguna: rubuta mana, mun san sana'ar. Amsa cikin awoyi {hours} na aiki, da Faransanci ko Turanci.

ui.schools.lead: Makarantun tuƙin jirgi, cibiyoyin horo, cibiyoyin jarrabawa: yi rijistar ƙungiyarka kyauta. Shafinka na jama'a na nuna shirye-shiryenka, yankinka da bayanan tuntuɓarka — kuma matuƙan gobe na samun ka ta lambar gidan waya, kamar yadda suke samun matuƙi.

ui.schools.step3_p: Matuƙan gobe na tuntuɓarka daga shafinka; ƙiyasin farashi, saƙonni da biyan kuɗi mai tsaro na faruwa a dandalin idan ka so.

ui.share.pilot_hint: Yaɗa wannan shafi: kowane rabawa na ba shi ƙarin adireshi ɗaya a yanar gizo.
ui.share.own_hint: Raba shafinka ga abokan cinikinka da a shafukanka na sada zumunta: ita ce hanya mafi kai tsaye ta samun ka.
ui.vis.title: Samun ka
ui.vis.views: An duba shafinka sau {n} cikin kwanaki 30 ({w} cikin kwanaki 7), ban da robot.
ui.vis.views_none: Babu wanda ya duba shafinka cikin kwanaki 30 (ban da robot): kowane abu a ƙasa na ƙara ganinsa.
ui.vis.blocking: Mai hanawa: muddin wannan ya ɓace, ba ka bayyana a wata hanya gabaɗaya.
ui.vis.done: Komai ya cika. Bayanan kanka sun cika.

seo.home.title: Hayar Matuƙin Drone Mai Lasisi — Ƙiyasin Farashi Kyauta | AubePilot
seo.home.description: Nemi ka ajiye matuƙin drone mai lasisi kusa da kai ta lambar gidan waya ko adireshi: hoto ta sama, bincike, aure, gidaje. Ƙiyasi kyauta, biya cikin riƙon amana.
seo.pilots_list.title: Matuƙan Drone Masu Lasisi don Haya | AubePilot
seo.pilots_list.title_place: Matuƙan Drone Masu Lasisi don Haya a {place} | AubePilot
seo.pilots_list.description: Kwatanta matuƙan drone masu lasisi: sharhi, farashi, lasisi da kayan aiki. Nemi ƙiyasin farashi kyauta don hoto ta sama, bincike da bukukuwa.
seo.pilots_list.description_place: Kwatanta matuƙan drone masu lasisi a {place}: sharhi, farashi, lasisi da kayan aiki. Nemi ƙiyasin farashi kyauta don hoto ta sama, bincike da bukukuwa.
seo.missions_list.title: Ayyukan Drone & Kwangiloli a Buɗe | AubePilot
seo.missions_list.description: Nemi ayyukan tuƙin drone kusa da kai ka aika ƙiyasin farashinka: bincike, ɗaukar bidiyo ta sama, bukukuwa, gidaje. Biya cikin riƙon amana.
seo.faq_page.title: Tambayoyin da Ake Yawan Yi — matuƙan drone, ƙiyasi, biya | AubePilot
seo.faq_page.description: Duk game da AubePilot: samun matuƙin drone ta lambar gidan waya, farashi, bayanan kai da aka tabbatar, riƙon amana, lasisin da ake karɓa, biyan matuƙa.
seo.part107_page.title: Matuƙan Drone na Part 107 a Amurka — FAA ta tabbatar | AubePilot
seo.part107_page.description: Nemi matuƙin drone mai lasisin FAA Part 107 ta lambar ZIP ka kwatanta ƙiyasi, ko yi rijistar shaidarka: an duba a rajistar FAA, alama a shafinka, gani a duniya.
seo.updates_page.title: Sabbin abubuwa — canje-canje ga matuƙa da abokan ciniki | AubePilot
seo.updates_page.description: Abubuwan da aka ƙara wa AubePilot wata bayan wata: taswira da yanayi, shafukan matuƙa, harsuna, nema, makarantu, ƙiyasi. Sabbi a farko.
seo.schools_page.title: Makarantun Horon Drone & Ƙungiyoyi | AubePilot
seo.schools_page.description: Yi rijistar makarantar horon drone ko ƙungiyarka: shafin jama'a da shirye-shiryenka (na asali, na gaba, A2, STS…), gani a taswira, buƙatu daga matuƙan gobe.
seo.contact_page.title: Tuntuɓe mu — AubePilot
seo.contact_page.description: Tambaya game da aiki, ƙiyasin farashi, bayanan matuƙinka ko haɗin gwiwa? Rubuta mana, muna amsawa da sauri.
